content.text:
Built a complete, playable **OVERDRIVE** coastal driving game in `index.html`.

It features a new Pacific Switchback level, traffic to dodge, drifting to charge the new **Slipstream Surge** mechanic, a 2,500 m Overdrive challenge, score and best-score tracking, and keyboard and touch controls. Assumed a self-contained, no-build browser game.

Verified the game renders and plays in Chromium. Screenshot: `screenshots/latest.jpg`. Start it with `./start.sh` in the project environment.
